description: Get a task by its human-friendly number (the #N shown in the UI) within a board. Resolves the number to the task UUID and returns full details (same shape as get_task). Handy when you know the #N but not the UUID.

board_slug.description: Board slug the task belongs to

number.description: Task number — the #N in the UI, without the '#'

name: get_task_by_number
title: Get task by number
